statement: Passing fixture, fingerprint, and release-build checks do not discharge an explicitly owed paired corpus delta. Cejel #459 widened a default-rubric handler pattern and recorded fixture changes, while issue #460 still requires a preregistered public-corpus before-and-after before the next release. The 0.6.4 candidate check also reproduced #430 and #427 at their reported target commits using a scorer tree verified against current main; the artifact's 0.6.3 version string alone would not identify that unreleased scorer. Rule: track corpus debt separately from fixture verification, pin scorer and target commits, and preregister before either paired arm runs.

movesWhen.reason: The preregistered paired corpus delta owed by Cejel issue #460 must be recorded before the next release.
